title: stachys riddellii
intro: Stachys riddellii, commonly known as Riddell's hedge nettle or Wood Betony, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae, native to the Americas. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its health benefits such as reducing pain and inflammation, as well as its use in treating various digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Stachys riddellii include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve anxiety and stress, and its application in treating skin conditions and wounds due to its antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents present in Stachys riddellii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
